name: Tetsuwan Gacchu!
source:
Akemi, Marika and Meimei were live on local radio station as usual when their director assassination occurred. After that the ultimate battle started between contestants to determine the personality of the "new Gacchu".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
明美、麻里香和美美像往常一样在地方广播电台进行直播时，节目导演遭到暗杀。此后，一场终极大战在参赛者之间打响，以决定谁能成为“新Gacchu”的主持人。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
